children: UBS now expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise the official cash rate twice before the end of this year, reaching 4.85% by November. The RBA is set to follow hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve, while elevated oil prices will also drive inflation up to 1.3% on quarter in 3Q, and to 3.8% annually, says George Tharenou, chief economist for Australia and NZ at UBS. Inflation over the last five years has averaged more than 4% on year in the U.S., Australia and New Zealand, which is far above central bank targets, and they are finally reacting, he adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
